pinv_semantics: pinv_r(x)=x^(-r) for integer x>0 and 0 for integer x<=0

shell_partition.construction: Cartesian product of the five exact coordinate activation classes
shell_partition.mirror_rule: swap the k and l coordinate classes
shell_partition.exactness: The classes are exhaustive and disjoint on the common n+3 box and make all eight protected pinv activation predicates constant.

shell_restriction_policy.ordinary_factors: On k=n+offset and/or l=n+offset, substitute the shell equality into every ordinary affine rational factor exactly; absorb nonzero constants and remove identically zero numerator terms.
shell_restriction_policy.protected_factors: Only the eight tagged n-k+s and n-l+s reciprocal factors use the protected pinv zero rule.

channel_manifest.l1_policy: derive l1 only after exact coefficient-layer k<->l mirror verification on every mirrored shell stratum

letter_orientation_policy.inside_independent_channels: Preserve distinct k- and l-oriented primitive harmonic letters.
letter_orientation_policy.sequence_level_quotient: Use the protected 13 k<->l orbit representatives only to assign oriented letters to the four harmonic weight blocks.
letter_orientation_policy.forbidden: Do not identify an l-oriented letter with its k-oriented representative as an algebraic equality inside an individual shift channel.

probe_envelope.formula: 4 independent channels * 4 harmonic blocks * 25 shell strata
probe_envelope.rank_kind: exact rank over Q of the 0/1 scalar-support incidence matrix on oriented primitive letters after exact full rational shell restriction

next_gate: Declare bounded correction-flux unknown bases only for structurally active cells and compute exact coefficient-matrix rank/consistency before any elimination.
